key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr Paranoimia][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:02C0
name: decode_interleaved_bits_to_rows
description: Reads a bit-interleaved block from the source buffer, separates odd and even bits into 16-bit words, and writes 256 words into the row of the destination selected by a small index.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr Paranoimia][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:0334
name: scan_past_disk_sync_marker
description: Advances the buffer pointer to the disk sync marker word and then past any consecutive sync markers.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr Paranoimia][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:034E
name: step_head_to_target_track
description: Moves the track counter one step at a time toward the requested track by pulsing the step and direction bits of the CIA-B port mirror until the position matches.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr Paranoimia][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:03B2
name: wait_for_disk_interrupt_flag
description: Busy-waits on the shadow interrupt request register until the disk bit is set, then acknowledges it by writing that bit back.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr Paranoimia][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:03D0
name: wait_for_disk_ready_line
description: Burns a fixed delay and then polls the disk status bit of the CIA-A port mirror until it clears.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr Paranoimia][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:03EC
name: release_drive_select_when_idle
description: Clears the low drive-select bits of the port mirror and waits while the status bit stays set, then zeroes the mirror.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr Paranoimia][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:0420
name: wait_for_cia_timer_flag
description: Polls the timer interrupt flag of the CIA-B shadow register until it is set, then returns.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr Paranoimia][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:043E
name: pulse_drive_select_line
description: Derives a drive-select bit from the low two bits of the argument, asserts it in the CIA-B port mirror, holds it through a fixed delay, releases it, and clears the mirror.

key: Blades of Steel (1990)(Novotrade)[cr Paranoimia][a].adf boot-block load +$800 to $020000 (4096 bytes):0:047E
name: enable_motor_and_pulse_select
description: Sets the drive motor bit in the CIA-B port mirror, pulses the drive-select line chosen by the argument's low bits, and marks the mirror as all ones.

name: program_blitter_from_block
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then loads its mask, modulo, pointer, control and size registers from a parameter block.

name: drain_status_until_quiet
description: Sets a fixed word in the game's data area and repeatedly calls two helpers, reading a status bit and a value until the returned upper word is zero.

name: forward_call_without_work
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns, adding no logic of its own.

name: copy_table_entry_to_buffers
description: Reads three 16-bit values from a table entry chosen by flag bits and stores them into two parallel buffers at an offset, substituting all-ones for one value when a flag bit is set.

name: bump_counter_between_calls
description: Calls two routines, increments a 16-bit counter in the game's data area, then calls a final routine.

name: store_split_longs_in_pairs
description: Writes two 32-bit values, each split into high and low halves, into two parallel records at a given index.

name: init_entry_from_lookup_table
description: Loads a 32-bit value from an indexed table, adds a 16-bit offset taken from the next table entry, and stores it with two words set to all-ones and one cleared.

name: build_bitplane_pair_descriptor
description: Fills a descriptor record for a bitplane pair from a source address and, when the mode value is not one, appends a second record offset by one row and clears the end entry.

name: update_clamped_axis_offsets
description: Updates horizontal and vertical offsets from the input positions when their flags are set, then clamps the stored horizontal offset into a bounded range.

name: pack_position_into_record_bytes
description: Packs horizontal and vertical start and end positions for one record into control bytes written to two buffers, clearing both when the remaining count reaches zero.

name: build_blitter_copy_request
description: Fills a blitter request record with the source address, block height and width and a standard copy control word, then runs the blit helpers.

name: queue_conditional_blit_request
description: When flag bits in the status byte select it, fills a blitter request record with a source address, a row offset chosen by a second flag, and a standard copy control word, then runs the blit helper.

name: flush_pending_blit_request
description: When a status bit is set, copies the stored address into a blit request record, runs the blit helper, and clears the record's completion word.

name: write_long_to_double_buffer
description: Copies a 32-bit value from an indexed pointer into two parallel buffers at a fixed offset, then calls two helpers.

name: setup_cia_timer_interrupt
description: Writes a sequence of values to the CIA-A timer and interrupt control registers and the interrupt enable register to set up a timer interrupt; some decompiled values are garbled.

name: handle_vertical_blank_tick
description: On a vertical blank interrupt flagged in the request mirror, advances frame counters and per-actor timers, runs update helpers when a timer expires, and acknowledges the interrupt.

name: stub_returns_stack_value
description: Only returns a value read from the stack without doing any work, so it is a stub with no behaviour.

name: swap_double_buffer_pointers
description: Exchanges front and back pointers for several double-buffered lists and writes the chosen list to the copper list pointer register.

name: compute_position_deltas_for_entry
description: Computes horizontal and vertical differences between two pairs of stored positions, copies a set of state fields from the source entry to the working entry, and clears a counter.

name: fill_eight_rows_with_ones
description: Computes a byte offset from the two arguments and a stored origin, then writes an all-ones byte into eight rows spaced by a fixed stride.

name: update_scroll_position_with_limits
description: Adjusts horizontal and vertical positions from direction flags and speed, clamps them to fixed limits, derives a word-aligned tile offset from the horizontal value, and calls a helper.

name: scan_and_mark_table_entry
description: Computes a table offset from three stored values, scans with helpers until a returned value is zero, then sets a pair of long markers to all-ones.

name: run_three_pass_blit_copy
description: Waits for the blitter before each of three passes, programs a standard copy control word, the source and destination addresses and the blit masks, then advances both addresses.

name: run_blit_passes_alt_order
description: Performs the same three blitter passes as its sibling routine but advances the source and destination addresses in the opposite order.

name: scatter_row_bytes_into_planes
description: Copies a 32-byte source block into four bitplane blocks, placing each byte at a fixed row stride within each plane after a computed offset.

name: copy_row_bytes_to_planes
description: Copies a 32-byte source block into four bitplane blocks at the same row stride as its sibling, without any offset computation.

name: build_paired_position_lists
description: Builds two lists of 32-bit position entries, storing each value as high and low halves, then writes a terminating word whose value comes from the remaining row count.

name: wait_then_clear_ready_flag
description: Busy-waits until the ready flag is set, then clears it.

name: start_blit_from_table_entry
description: Looks up a source address in a table by index, waits for the blitter to be idle, then programs its control, mask, modulo, pointer and size registers.

name: copy_words_to_three_buffers
description: Copies thirty-two 16-bit values from the input block into three parallel buffers, with a four-byte stride in two of them.

name: clear_pending_flag_word
description: Clears a 16-bit flag word in the game's data area.

name: reset_actor_state_words
description: Sets several position and status words in the game's data area to all-ones or zero, establishing a clean initial state.

name: dispatch_three_update_steps
description: Calls one routine with an adjusted base address and then two further routines in sequence, with no logic of its own.

name: copy_sixteen_words_then_process
description: Copies sixteen 16-bit values from the argument block into a fixed data-area table and then calls a routine on that table.

name: draw_rows_until_helper_done
description: When an enabled flag is set, fills a draw record with position, size and mask values and repeatedly calls a helper, advancing the destination by a fixed stride, until it returns zero; a second pass runs when another value is set.

name: render_clipped_entry_rows
description: Iterates over eight entries; for each active one it computes a screen position, clips it to the playfield bounds, and when visible writes blit control values and calls a helper for four rows.
